flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4102 then book a free first visit for Sam Rivera, email sam@example.com, on the second of November 2026 at noon.
Accept the waiver.
Then verify a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown
Get the reference code from the booking confirmation and save as {{ref}}.

remark: click: Clicking Book a free first visit button
wait: queued plan (6 steps): type "Your name"; type "Email address"; type "Visit date"
select: Selecting 12pm (noon) in the arrival time selector
click: Checking the climbing waiver acceptance checkbox
click: Clicking Confirm my free visit button
analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, 'the reference code from the booking confirmation is sav
assert: a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown

summary:
Booked a free first visit for Sam Rivera using sam@example.com for November 2, 2026 at 12:00 PM.
Accepted the waiver.
The booking was confirmed and the reference code PL-4821 was saved.
one_liner: booked a free first visit on the local booking site
